title: No Preference Left Behind: Group Distributional Preference Optimization
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspect of faith or religion. It focuses on aligning language models with distributional preferences on global issues and movie reviews.
findings: This paper does not analyze or report any findings related to religion or faith.
